_comment: API surface tiers for BranchWeaver, decided by reading every type and challenging every proposed removal. published = shown in the reference; headline = the types a new buyer meets first; hidden = public for cross-assembly reasons only, excluded from the reference and marked non-browsable; internal = no longer public. Types the narrative documentation links to were promoted out of hidden: if a guide points at it, it is API.
